Description
Ravensbourne is a forward-thinking university in the heart of London, empowering bold minds at the crossroads of business, creativity, and technology. We offer foundation, undergraduate, and postgraduate courses that are designed with industry in mind, ensuring our graduates have the skills and experience to thrive in the workforce. 
Learning and collaborating with industry is central to the Ravensbourne experience. Ravensbourne students build connections with practitioners from day one, and work on real-life projects and work placements with recognised global brands. We are ranked among the top 10 UK universities for employability (Uni Compare 2025) and in the top 5 London universities as rated by students (Student Crowd 2024).
With a diverse student community from over 100 countries, Ravensbourne fosters collaboration across disciplines, offering a global perspective that prepares graduates to make an impact worldwide.
